messages:
deployment-bot: ALERT: Canary errors for rollout 'checkout-nlg-v2' > 8% over last 5m. Errors are 502s and backend timeouts. Canary variant: gptx-8k-q3-canary. Fallback policy: sticky -> gptx-4k-stable. Smart-routing shows cross-region churn between eu-west and us-west. Paging oncall (priority P1).

Ellie: hitting this, on it. @Priya (oncall) can you take first oncall? I need logs + current routing policy.

Priya (oncall): i'm on. seeing a spike in avg latency from 220ms -> 420ms for eu-west and a 3% global error rate increase. Canary hosts throwing OOM-ish traces: "kv_cache_miss leading to allocation spike" in the runtime logs.

Sam: looks like when canary fails, smart-routing fallback is sticky to the stable variant, but because canary was pinned to eu-west, sticky fallback nodes in us-west are getting requests routed back to eu-west repeatedly (sticky affinity + region fallback mismatch). That's causing cross-region retries and increased p99.

Cass: confirming. Route trace example: 
```
request_id=abc123 path=/generate -> routed eu-west:gptx-8k-q3-canary (503) -> fallback sticky to eu-west:gptx-4k-stable -> smart-router sees healthy capacity in us-west and attempts warm start -> ends up sending traffic back to eu-west due to fallback affinity -> loop observed
```

Miguel: any customer impact numbers? product is asking.

Priya (oncall): early estimate: ~3% of requests seeing errors, EU customers see 10-12% latency inflation for generation endpoints. No large customers fully down but some saw increased error budgets in dashboards.

product-lead: flagging: two mid-market customers reported partial degradation to support. Need quick mitigation plan and communication.

Ellie: immediate plan: 1) Pause rollout 2) Disable sticky fallback for this rollout (switch to simple non-sticky fallback) 3) Drain canary by draining 100% of new traffic to stable 4) If needed, pin region routing to local region for EU to avoid cross-region churn. Agreed?

Sam: agree. Commands to run: 
```
# pause rollout
rctl rollout pause --name checkout-nlg-v2 --actor ellie
# flip fallback policy to non-sticky for route
rctl route update --route=checkout.generate --fallback-policy=non-sticky --actor ellie
# drain canary
rctl rollout set-traffic --name checkout-nlg-v2 --variant=gptx-8k-q3-canary --traffic 0 --actor ellie
```

Ellie: executing now.

deployment-bot: ACTION: rctl rollout pause accepted (actor: ellie).

eng-runtime-bot: CONFIG_CHANGE: route checkout.generate fallback-policy updated to non-sticky (actor: ellie). Note: this will remove affinity cookies for fallback.

Ellie: can everyone verify traffic cameras and router traces?

Cass: after flip, I see fallback decisions now go to gptx-4k-stable in the same region without re-routing back. No sticky affinity tokens observed.

Priya (oncall): errors dropping to 0.8% in next 2m window. EU p95 back to ~230ms. Looks stable.

product-lead: prepping a short status update: "Canary rollout paused due to increased errors; fallback policy adjusted; traffic returned to stable variant; mitigation in place. Customers impacted briefly; engineering investigating root cause."

Sam: root-cause hypothesis: the canary's memory/kv-cache config differs (new KV cache eviction threshold) causing higher cache churn and pressure; combined with sticky fallback affinity led to cross-region amplification. Need to compare canary runtime config to stable.

Miguel: assigning followups: eng-runtime to run diff on runtime configs, eng-sre to add guardrail for sticky fallback when canary and region mismatches exist, product to coordinate customer comms.

Ellie: logging action items here: 
- ENG-RUNTIME: config diff + patch to canary (priority P0)
- ENG-SRE: add policy lint in routing controller to prevent sticky fallback across regions (P1)
- OBS: add dashboard for fallback loop detection (P1)
- PRODUCT: send customer note template (P1)

Cass: quick note — we should also add a rollout presubmit check: if variant is region-constrained then disallow sticky fallback for rollouts.

eng-runtime-bot: NOTE: Collected canary runtime config snapshot at 2178123600 -> file s3://redwood-incidents/canary-snapshots/checkout-nlg-v2/2178123600.json

Priya (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. Will keep thread open for postmortem. Time to mitigation ~ 7 minutes from page.

product-lead: customer comms draft done, will ship after engineering confirms RCA.

Ellie: thanks all. tagging owners on followups. I'll create the postmortem stub and link to this thread.

deployment-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated (incident_id=INC-2026-2178123456) status -> mitigated.

Miguel: quick blameless note — this was a policy interaction (canary config + sticky fallback + region affinity). No code rollback required, but config hardening needed.

Ellie: closing handoff to eng-runtime and eng-sre for RCA and followups. I'll ping when draft postmortem is ready.

Sam: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Cass: adding one more artifact: router traces and example request_id list uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/traces/checkout-nlg-v2/217812-traces.json

Priya (oncall): last check: error rate steady at 0.6% and p95 normal. I'm removing pages for oncall.

Ellie: final note for postmortem: include a replay test that simulates canary OOM patterns to validate routing controller behavior.

deployment-bot: THREAD CLOSED for INC-2026-2178123456 (closed_by=Ellie, closed_at=2178123879)
